general_information.Description: The course is to provide students with some most advantage knowledge in DataBase field: - Conceptual Database Design (review) - Methodology – Logical Database Design for the Relational Model (review) - Methodology – Physical Database Design for Relational Databases (review) - Distributed DBMSs – Concepts and Design - Overview of Networking - Functions and Architectures of a Distributed DBMSs - Object-Oriented DBMSs – Concepts and Design - Weakness of Relational DBMSs - Storing Objects in a Relational Database - Issues in Object Oriented DBMSs - Advantages and Disadvantages of Object Oriented DBMSs - Object Data Standard ODMG 3.0 - Object-Relational DBMSs - Security and Administration - Transaction Management - Query Processing - Introduce to Data mining and Data Warehousing This course will also first step introduce to students using Oracle (10g version) like DBMS on work.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. '- Student is responsible to do all exercises and qiuz given by lecturer in class or at home and submit on time. - Constantly follow announcements on intranet/CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.

description: The course is to provide students with some most advantage knowledge in DataBase field: - Conceptual Database Design (review) - Methodology – Logical Database Design for the Relational Model (review) - Methodology – Physical Database Design for Relational Databases (review) - Distributed DBMSs – Concepts and Design - Overview of Networking - Functions and Architectures of a Distributed DBMSs - Object-Oriented DBMSs – Concepts and Design - Weakness of Relational DBMSs - Storing Objects in a Relational Database - Issues in Object Oriented DBMSs - Advantages and Disadvantages of Object Oriented DBMSs - Object Data Standard ODMG 3.0 - Object-Relational DBMSs - Security and Administration - Transaction Management - Query Processing - Introduce to Data mining and Data Warehousing This course will also first step introduce to students using Oracle (10g version) like DBMS on work.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: studied chapters knowledge and skills: Task 1: DB Analyze & Design and DBMSs' Technology Solutions (40%) Task 2: DB Implement and Programming based on a selected DBMS (20%) Task 3: Project or Task Presentation (40%)

schedule.Topic: Enhanced Entity - Relationship Modeling - Specialization/Generalization - Aggregation - Composition Overview of the Database Design Methology Conceptual Database Design Methodology - Identify entity types, relationship types, attributes - Determine keys - Consider use of enhanced ER modeling - Check model for redundancy - Validate conceptual data model

Logical Database Design for the Relational Model - Derive relations for logical data model - Validate relations using normalization - Validate relations against user transactions - Review logical data model - Check for future growth Physical DB Design for Relational Databases. - Introduction. - Comparison of Logical and Physical DB Design. - Overview of the Physical DB Design Methodology. - The Physical DB Design Methodology for Relational Databases.

Monitoring and Tuning the Operational System. - Denormalizing and Introducing Controlled Redundancy. - Monitoring the System to Improve Performance Transaction Management: -Transaction suport -Concurrency control -Database recovery

Transaction Management (cont): -Advanced transaction models -Concurrency control and recovery in Oracle (given for self-study) Query Processing -Overview -Query decomposition -Heuristical approach to Q Optimization
Query Processing (cont) -Cost estimation -Enumeration of alternative Execution strategies -Query optimization in Oracle Review of Part 4,5
Distributed DBMSs – Concepts and Design: - Concepts - Overview of Networking - Function and architectures - Distributed relational Database design

Distributed DBMSs – Concepts and Design (cont) - Tranparencies in a DDBMs - Date's Twenlve rules in a DDBMs Distributed DBMSs – Advanced Concepts: - Distributed transaction managment - Distributed concurrency control - Distributed deadlock management
Guide Exercises/Project Task(s) Activity for Distributed DBMSs – Concepts and Design
Distributed DBMSs – Advanced Concepts (cont): - Distributed Database recovery + Two-phase commit (2PC) + Three-phase commit (3PC) - Distributed query optimization - Distributed in Oracle
Replication and mobile Database: - Introdution to Database replication - Replication servers - Introdution to mobile DataBase - Oracle replication Review of Part 6
Quiz 2 Object-Oriented DBMSs - Concepts and Design - Weakness of RDBMSs - Storing Objects in a Relational Database - Introduction to Object Oriented DBMSs - Persistentce
OODBMSs standards and systems - Object management group - Object data standard ODMG 3.0 - Object store

Object-Relational DBMSs - Introduction to Object-Relational Database Systems - The Third-Generation Database manifestos - Object Oriented extensions in Oracle - Comparison of ORDBMS and OODBMS Security and Administration (given for self-study)
